title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent-fixing
requirement: It is unlawful for a real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise use a service provider; no service provider may facilitate an agreement not to compete among lessors on rental pricing, fees, or other rental terms.
coverage_conditions: Applies to residential dwelling units; binds real estate lessors, agents, subcontractors, and service providers.
quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for or otherwise utilize the services of a Service Provider.
